context.//: Emit templates without indentation. The control-plane API stack embeds the generated OpenAPI spec, which had pushed its template to 1,007,482 bytes — past CloudFormation's 1,000,000-byte ceiling, so it could not be deployed and CDK could not even build a change set for it. Dropping indentation takes that template to 590,805 bytes. Templates in cdk.out become one long line; use `cdk synth <stack>` or pipe through a formatter when reading them by hand.
